title: Social Content & Suggestions
notes: social/page.tsx rebuilt on ListPage: PageHeader+count, FilterBar, hover row actions (Copy/Eye/Trash2), infinite scroll, detail drawer with inline edit+copy, skeleton, bulk delete, full-dataset CSV export. Wired generate/generate-batch via a Generate dialog gated by useFeatureGate('ai_assistant') (disabled/upgrade state, no 403 toast). Added a Suggestions panel (list/generate/accept/dismiss) also gated by ai_assistant, degrading to an upgrade message when disabled or the AI provider errors. festivals/page.tsx already met the contract (FilterBar, infinite scroll, skeleton, empty state) as a card-grid gallery; left as-is since it is not a tabular list. relationCombobox/phoneInput/addressAutocomplete/currencyInput/sendMessageDialog N/A — no relation fields, contact fields, money fields, or outbound messaging in this slice. No RelationCombobox or contact-field types apply here.
showcaseScript: Generate a batch of Instagram captions for a destination
Edit one and mark it approved
Review AI festival-offer suggestions and accept one
